- Tue 2026-10-06 10:15–10:30 PT
- Wed 2026-10-07 16:00–16:15 PT

If none of these work I will open the calendar again, but I want to make sure we don't lose momentum. I've attached a brief demo agenda and a draft SOW excerpt for context (Quantix-SOW-draft-v2.pdf, demo-agenda.md).

Thanks — a quick one-line reply is perfect.

Best,
